title: NSW Kick-off Workshop
description: The inaugural workshop of the National Single Window project, with participation from representatives of all regulatory agencies, the private sector, and international partners. The project vision, implementation plan, and the roles of each party were presented.

title: CBRA Data Harmonization Workshop
location: Conference Center, Ministry of Economy and Innovation, Tirana
description: Technical workshop focused on harmonizing data formats between the 8 cross-border regulatory agencies. UN/CEFACT standards, harmonized codes, and specific requirements of each agency were discussed.

title: NSW Technical Architecture Review
description: Technical review of the NSW system architecture with international experts. The main platform components, integration mechanisms with ASYCUDA, and plans for pilot phase testing will be presented.

title: Trader Registration Training for NSW
location: Chamber of Commerce and Industry, Tirana
description: Practical training session for traders, customs brokers, and freight forwarders on the registration process and use of the NSW platform. The LPCO application submission process will be demonstrated.
